mechanism_narrative: The one-week improvement in RETAIL_REC from -59.1 to -53.9 marks the start of a recovery momentum that persists over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than the last 28-day mean despite the t-0w RETAIL_REC improvement.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility rising by more than 10 percentage points week-on-week signals a release of pent-up demand for out-of-home activities, which lifts retail and recreation footfall over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT increases by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If after a >10 point weekly rise in TRANSIT, RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improve together, the combined return of commuting and public transport use generates higher weekday retail footfall, driving RETAIL_REC up over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If in weeks when WORKPLACES > -45 and TRANSIT > -55, RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of easing restrictions, rising PARKS mobility reflects increased outdoor social activity that spills over into nearby retail and recreation spending, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -21.1 to -9.3 over four weeks
failure_condition: If during easing restrictions, a PARKS level above -15 is not followed by a higher 7-day RETAIL_REC mean.

mechanism_narrative: The narrowing of GROCERY_PHARM decline from -9.0 to -4.9 indicates normalization of essential shopping routines; as grocery trips become more frequent, consumers also make discretionary retail stops, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM > -7.0 does not lead to a higher next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains below -50, work-from-home mandates are still suppressing weekday commuter footfall, which drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES < -50 is observed and RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal transition to winter in Sydney reduces PARKS visits, and lower park activity predicts reduced foot traffic in adjacent retail strips, causing RETAIL_REC to fall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS falls below -15 and RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not lower than last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility falls while TRANSIT rises, it signals people are shifting from staying home to using public transport, which increases retail and recreation mobility over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL decreases by >3 points and TRANSIT increases by >5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If such simultaneous changes occur and RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher.
